description: Lists the Diagnostics in the connected Yellowhead account, newest first. Each item has its id, business name, website, status (queued, processing, completed or failed; a run with no result after 15 minutes is reported as failed), client_id, MIDAS score once complete, and created date. Diagnostics are visible across the whole account, not only to the person who ran them. Filters: client_id (one client workspace) and since (created on or after a date and time). An empty page means none were returned for these filters, not that none exist. Fits questions like "what Diagnostics do we have" and "is my Diagnostic ready", and finding two runs to compare.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list response.

since.description: Only diagnostics created at/after this RFC 3339 timestamp.
